fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car, a 2009 Toyota Corolla sedan.
findings: Red paint on the hood, doors and rear quarter looks glossy overall, though heavy dappled shade from trees hides much of the finish
Some minor haze on the front bumper and fenders
Black front floor mat on the passenger side looks like it could use a vacuum
Light gray dash, console and cloth seats look clean, with a little dust visible on the dash and console
Headlights look fairly clear, with a light haze on the driver side lens
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the red Corolla and it looks like it has been well kept. A wash and wax would sharpen up the gloss on the red paint, and a quick interior touch-up would freshen the light gray dash and the floor mats before buyers see it. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
